spec.name: Pandoran Glowspire
spec.description: A tall bioluminescent alien plant: a dark indigo spiral-veined stalk rising from a root mound into a crown of glowing fronds, ringed by three huge unfurling helicoradian coils and clusters of lit ground pods.
spec.layout: Front (+Z) view: a low root mound 0.4 m tall fills the footprint, its rim carrying buttress roots, moss, glowing mushroom clusters and lit ground pods. From the mound centre a single dark indigo stalk rises with a gentle forward-then-back lean to 2.3 m, wrapped in glowing vertebra rings at each spine joint. At the crown hub the stalk opens into a fan of 8-10 broad teal fronds that arc out and down to a 2.0 m spread, every frond edged and veined in bright cyan light, with glowing spore pods hanging beneath them. Three helicoradian coils anchor to the mound ring: one front-left, one back-right, one front-right, each a thin stem curling into a huge spiralled frond sheet up to 1.5 m tall, its rim glowing pink-cyan. All silhouettes are bold low-poly curves; every light line, vein and pod is its own small glowing part against the dark flora colours.

parts.builds: The ground piece: a smooth lathe or lofted mound of dark soil (soil) rising from y=0 to about 0.35 m at the centre and thinning to a lip at radius ~0.9 m, with 5-7 buttress roots in rootPlum flaring out of the mound sides like low fins, each tipped with a tiny glowCyan stud. Moss patches (moss) as flat painted blotches or thin slabs on upward faces. Two features cluster on the mound: a group of 5 glowing mushrooms (capViolet domes on short stems, gillCyan undersides and stem rings, all glow kit lit) near the front-left, and a cluster of 3 teardrop ground pods in rootPlum with vertical glowPink slit lights and glowCyan rim rims near the front-right. Scatter small glowCyan pebble-lights over the soil. The stalk passes through the mound centre; leave a collar of dark bark there so stalkFoot reads as planted. This part owns joints base, coilA, coilB, coilC.
parts.attaches: Owns the floor (floor: true). Its top centre is the stalkFoot mount where the stalk emerges; its mound surface at the three coilAnchor points is where the coils root.

parts.builds: The main trunk: one sweep along the base-stalk1-stalk2-stalk3-crown chain, radius tapering from ~0.11 m at the foot to ~0.05 m under the crown, catmull through the joint positions so the lean reads. Bark in bark with a subtle two-tone mottle or gradient toward barkLight on up-facing sides; section circle with modest sides for a faceted look. Signature detail: at each spine joint, a glowing vertebra ring in glowCyan (a thin band or ring of small studs seated on the bark via surface loop/along), and 2-3 rows of small blister studs in barkLight climbing the trunk between rings. Near the foot, two short bark thorn frustumBoxes or spikes lean against the trunk. Add 3-4 tiny glowBlue lichen dots scattered up the shaded side. The crown joint tops out at the crownHub mount; cap the sweep with a small bud in frondDark so the canopy sits on it.
parts.attaches: Emerges from rootMound at the stalkFoot mount (its buried foot continues into the mound); its top ends at the crownHub mount where canopy attaches.

parts.builds: The glowing crown: around the crownHub mount, a ring of 8-10 fronds built as b.ring frames about the crown line, each frond an extruded leaf shape (smooth 2, thickness tapering 0.02 to 0.004) curving outward and down like an umbrella, sized 0.5-0.8 m. Frond bodies in frondDark with the outer third fading to frondMid via gradient; every frond carries 3-5 thin vein slabs or rod lines in glowCyan running root to tip, plus a glowCyan rim edge, all glow-lit. Between fronds, the central bud at the hub: a small lathe dome in frondMid with a glowViolet tip light. Beneath the fronds hang 6-8 spore pods on thin stalk rods: small lathe or capsule pods in sporeGold and glowPink, alternating, each glowing softly, dangling at varied lengths 0.15-0.3 m. Group the fronds under 3-4 fan group joints created with b.ring joints option so they can be posed together.
parts.attaches: Roots entirely at the crownHub mount on top of the stalk; hanging pods stay above rootMound's box and clear of the coils.

parts.builds: Three helicoradian spirals, one per coilAnchor mount, each riding its coil joint: a thin stem rod (stemCoil, radius ~0.02) rising from the anchor and curling over via a catmull or spiral path up to 1.2-1.5 m, then a huge unfurling frond sheet built as a membrane or lofted ribbon following a spiral that tightens toward the tip, in frondDark with the curl edge in frondMid. Each coil's outer rim carries a continuous glowPink edge line (a thin swept band along the rim) and 4-6 glowCyan vein rods across the sheet, glow-lit. Vary the three coils: coilA tallest and leaning right-forward, coilB shorter and curled tighter, coilC mid-height unfurling toward the front so the trio reads as a family, not copies. Each stem base gets a small mound collar and 2 root fins in rootPlum to seat it on the mound. Keep the inner volumes clear of the stalk box.
parts.attaches: Each coil stems from its named coilAnchor mount on the rootMound surface, geometry riding its coilA/coilB/coilC joint; tips stay inside the box, below the canopy.

calls.reasoning:
I need to write a spec JSON for a bioluminescent alien plant in Avatar (Pandora) style. 3-6 parts splitting work evenly. Avatar style: bioluminescent flora, glowing cyan/blue/purple spiral shapes, helicoradian-like spiral plants, glowing tendrils, dark teal foliage, magenta/cyan glow.

Think of a composition: a hero plant — a large bioluminescent stalk/tree with a curling canopy of glowing fronds, plus spiral helicoradian-like coils, glowing ground pods/mushrooms at base, and floating spore pods. Central stalk with fronds, side tendrils.

Parts (4):
1. rootBase: root mound, ground bulbs, glowing mushrooms/pods at base (floor: true).
2. trunkStalk: main stalk chains with glowing spine rings.
3. canopyFronds: glowing fronds/leaves at top of stalk.
4. sideTendrils: spiral helicoradian coils and vine tendrils around the base.

Maybe 5 parts: add floating spore pods. Keep 4-5.

Size: height ~2.4 m plant, width ~2.0, depth ~2.0. Let's say [2.2, 2.6, 2.0]. Center on x=0. Base at y=0.

Joints: a static model could have joints for animation — bioluminescent plant could sway. Provide joints: root, stalk1-3 (spine), frond branches (fan), coil stems (hinge/spiral). Keep skeleton modest: root "base", chain joints for stalk: stalk1, stalk2, stalk3, head. Fronds ring group joints. Coils each a joint.

Define joints in order parents first:
- base at [0, 0.15, 0], dir [0,1,0], role spine, no parent (root)
- stalk1 parent base at [0,0.5,0.05], dir [0,1,0.15], role spine
- stalk2 parent stalk1 at [0,1.1,0.18], dir [0,1,0.1], role spine
- stalk3 parent stalk2 at [0,1.7,0.28], dir [0,1,-0.05], role spine
- crown parent stalk3 at [0,2.2,0.22], dir [0,1,-0.1], role neck (or spine)
- frondRing: role fan joints? Ring joints created by builders though — spec says joints list created before parts run; ring group joints can be created by parts via b.ring with joints option. But spec's joints array lists skeleton. I can list a few fan joints: frondA..frondF parent crown. Let ring builder create them? Simpler: list them in joints array so order is fixed.

Let me define: crown at [0,2.2,0.22]; frond joints f1..f8? That's many. Maybe 6 frond joints with role fan, group fronds. But each part builder will use b.ring with joints option creating group joints — but those wouldn't be in the shared joints list and two builders can't rely on them. To keep coordination simple, list fan joints explicitly in the joints array.

Coil plants: helicoradian spirals — 3 coils around base, each with one joint: coilA, coilB, coilC, parent base, role fan or tentacle. Give role "tentacle"? Roles list: spine neck head jaw hinge tail leg arm wing digit tentacle fan. Spiral coils: "tentacle" fits.

Also side tendrils on the stalk: hang from stalk, role hinge maybe. Keep simple.

Parts:

1. "baseRoots" (builder rootBase): root mound, buttress roots, glowing pod clusters/mushrooms at ground, floor true, box [[-1.0, 0, -0.9],[1.0, 0.45, 1.0]], budget ~200.

2. "stalk": main trunk sweep chain stalk1..crown, bark texture via paint, glowing spine rings/vertebrae lights along it, box [[-0.45,0.3,-0.3],[0.45,2.35,0.6]], budget 180.

3. "canopy": glowing fronds from crown — big translucent-ish flat leaves, fan of 6-9 fronds, each extrude/slab with glow veins, plus spore pods hanging, box [[-1.0,1.9,-0.9],[1.0,2.6,0.7]], budget 220.

4. "coils": 3 helicoradian spirals with huge spiraling frond membranes, box [[-1.1,0,-1.0],[1.1,1.5,1.0]], budget 220.

5. maybe "spores": floating spore pods + ground vines glowing, box around base to mid, budget 100. Could merge into baseRoots and coils. 4 parts is fine, but spec says 3-6 parts splitting evenly; 4 parts budget ~825 total ok.

Let me add a 5th "tendrils": hanging vine tendrils from stalk with glowing tips, and undergrowth ferns around base between coils. Budget 120. Actually keep 4 parts, cleaner: baseRoots 200, stalk 200, canopy 230, coils 220 = 850.
